item.title: Crossroads Church fires Next Gen program director for secretly recording women at Oakley gym, church says
item.description: An email sent to members of the church, obtained by WCPO and confirmed by Crossroads, said the church received a call from Cincinnati police Thursday regarding the situation.

item.title: Norwood High School names Armand Tatum as its head football coach
item.description: Norwood High School named Armand Tatum as its head football coach on Friday night. Tatum has more than 20 years of experience coaching high school football in Ohio.

item.title: Hundreds across Tri-State rally against ICE operations in Minneapolis
item.description: Renee Good and Alex Pretti were shot and killed by ICE agents during an enforcement action, prompting the national day of action that reached from Hamilton County to Anderson.
